notes: Identity: p.1 lines 0–7 identify Clinical Psychology & Psychotherapy, 2025, 32:e70057; DOI 10.1002/cpp.70057; RESEARCH ARTICLE; matching title and all five replication authors. Supplied canonical cache contains page-labeled full-PDF text, methods, results, discussion, tables, endnotes and references across 12 pages with overlapping cached chunks. No local PDF supplied; no layout rendering possible within permitted sources. Antecedent discrepancy: p.12 lines 914–917 identify Owen, Hilsenroth and Rodolfa (2013), Interaction Among Alliance, Psychodynamic–Interpersonal and Cognitive–Behavioural Techniques in the Prediction of Post-Session Change, Clinical Psychology & Psychotherapy 20:513–522. This differs from the input original Alliance in action by Owen, Reese, Quirk and Rodolfa. Original side unassigned and not inspected. No unique interaction target selected. Printed candidates: Table 2 PI × WAI unstandardized B=−0.439, standardized Beta=−0.281, t=−3.250, p=0.002 (exact); CB × WAI B=0.245, Beta=0.217, t=2.598, p=0.011 (exact); PI × CB × WAI B=−0.096, Beta=−0.080, t=−0.895, p=0.373 (exact). Common regression N=106 is explicitly printed and retained only as a candidate pending field-scope review. No N sum or df derivation.
